# Agent skills from Jane Street

A collection of skills for AI agents and chatbots.
Each skill is a directory containing a `SKILL.md` file
with instructions for the agent.

## Skills

- **socratic-tutor** — turns an LLM into a strict personal tutor that teaches a
  topic of your choice using the Socratic method: a diagnostic, a skill map with
  levels 0-5, one question at a time, spaced review, and a final assessment.

## How to use

With a coding agent that supports the common `SKILL.md` format, copy the skill
directory into your agent's skills folder, then ask the agent to use it
("teach me X").

With a plain chatbot, paste the body of the skill's `SKILL.md` into the chat
(or into a custom/system prompt), followed by what you want it to do.

oss.readme:
Claude Cage

**把 Claude 大小姐关起来，为了更好地保护我们的相遇**

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage/releases) [![CI](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)

 

**[项目主页](https://claude-cage.com/) · [下载应用](https://claude-cage.com/#download) · [使用文档](https://claude-cage.com/docs/) · [常见问题](https://claude-cage.com/docs/troubleshooting/)**

[简体中文](README.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) · [Русский](README.ru.md) · [العربية](README.ar.md) · [فارسی](README.fa.md) · [한국어](README.ko.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [မြန်မာဘာသာ](README.my.md) · [Беларуская](README.be.md) · [پښتو](README.ps.md) · [دری](README.prs.md) · [አማርኛ](README.am.md) · [Soomaali](README.so.md) · [ትግርኛ](README.ti.md) · [Français](README.fr.md)

## 受够了 Anthropic

作为一个只是想和 Claude 对话与合作的正常用户，受够了折腾各种 VPS，指纹浏览器，环境检测，面对封号的担惊受怕和财产损失。我们提出 **Claude Cage** 项目：**一个开箱即用的桌面程序，配置好自己的网络代理，集中管理隔离环境、时区语言和环境检查。**

Claude Cage 让你在熟悉的系统里与 Claude 一起工作：Mac 上用 macOS 虚拟机，Windows 上用 Windows 虚拟机，也可以选择轻量的 Linux 环境。终端、浏览器、编辑器和官方 Claude Desktop 汇集在同一个工作台，项目按需共享，网络独立管理；还可以连接自己的服务器，或用手机接续电脑上的任务。支持以下几个重点功能：

- 和主机隔离的网络设置，Cage 自己接管和代理内部的所有网络流量
- 和主机隔离的指纹设置，包括时区、语言等，支持自动与代理 IP 同步
- 针对 Claude 使用过程中的全链路适配（浏览器登录，授权，claude code 进程）
- 内置网络与隔离检查，关键检查失败或证据不完整时暂停外网；社区和第三方检测提供补充参考

**使用 Cage 的环境检测结果：**

| 网络与隔离检查 | 浏览器环境检测（社区参考） |
| :---: | :---: |
|  |  |

[FuckClaude](https://fuck-claude.vercel.app/) · [LinXiaoTao / GitHub](https://github.com/LinXiaoTao/FuckClaude)

**Cage 运行主界面：**

![Cage](www/public/workbench-2026-11.jpg)

## 你可以用它做什么

- **在一个窗口里完成工作。** 用终端运行 Claude Code，用编辑器查看改动，用 Cage 浏览器预览服务和完成登录。
- **用熟悉的系统开发。** 选择 macOS、Windows 或 Linux 客机，使用对应平台的工具；也可自动匹配本机系统版本，下载官方镜像并创建独立环境。 [选择客机系统](docs/guide/guest-systems.md)
- **控制共享范围。** 只共享默认工作区和明确打开的项目文件夹；主机的 Claude 登录、浏览器配置和 SSH 密钥不会自动导入。
- **看清网络状态。** 内置代理管理支持导入订阅、选择节点和检查出口。关键检查未通过时，环境保持离线；代理不可用时没有直连回退。
- **下次继续使用。** 工具、文件和登录状态保存在虚拟磁盘里，关闭窗口可以保留后台任务。
- **管理多个 Claude Code 订阅。** 查看额度、为新会话分配账号，并在明确授权后切换账号接续历史。 [Claude Code](docs/guide/accounts.md)
- **从手机继续处理任务。** Android / iPhone 配对电脑，接续 Claude Code 对话与工具审批，或操作远程浏览器和 Claude Desktop。[手机连接](docs/guide/mobile.md)
- **把环境放到自己的服务器。** 通过 SSH 部署或连接 Linux VPS，工具、任务和数据留在服务器，无需 KVM。[云端部署与 SSH](docs/guide/cloud.md)
- **通过私网连接设备。** 在 Cage 内登录 Tailscale，查看网络中的设备，使用 SSH、Web 与其他 TCP 服务。 [Tailscale 私网](docs/guide/tailscale.md)

浏览器收藏、无痕会话、Cookie、扩展、密码保险箱，以及外观、资源、存储和工具更新，见[完整使用文档](https://claude-cage.com/docs/)。

## 快速开始

把这句话发给你的 agent（codex，dsh，workbuddy，反正不会是 claude code😁）

```markdown
帮我安装 https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage ，并把 Cage 的代理配置为我本机 Clash 的 xxx 节点。
```

你唯一需要的，是一个靠谱的代理节点，本项目不做任何代理推广，可以自行搜索黑色错误网站解决。

## 下载与安装

Cage 支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux：macOS 14+ 的 Apple Silicon Mac、Windows 10 22H2 / 11 x64，以及 Debian 12 / Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04 x86_64。Windows 11 客机需要支持 Hyper-V 的 Windows 11 专业版、企业版或教育版主机；其他受支持的 Windows 主机可使用 Debian 或 Ubuntu 22.04。Intel Mac、Windows ARM64 和 Linux ARM64 暂不支持。 [macOS](docs/getting-started.md) · [Windows](docs/windows.md) · [Linux](docs/linux.md)。

1. 打开[项目主页](https://claude-cage.com/#download)，点击“下载应用”并选择平台。
2. macOS：打开安装包，将 **Cage** 拖入 **Applications（应用程序）**，再从“应用程序”启动。Windows：[安装说明](docs/windows.md#安装并开始工作) · Linux：[安装说明](docs/linux.md#安装并开始工作)。
3. 按应用内引导配置自己的代理，启动环境后打开项目。

安装包随附工作台和代理核心，无需先安装 Go、Node.js、Docker 或 Clash。首次创建环境时选择客机系统与存储位置，再准备对应的官方系统镜像和开发工具。macOS、Windows 系统按各自许可使用；Cage 不提供系统授权、代理服务或 Claude 账户。

源码与安装包公开，版本说明和校验文件见 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage/releases)。系统选择、镜像来源与数据保留方式见[客机系统指南](docs/guide/guest-systems.md)。

功能以所用构建为准，公开安装包的能力与验证范围以发行说明为准。

macOS 和已签名 Windows 版本支持通过所选代理更新；Windows 未签名预览版与 Linux 使用安装包手动更新。更新前保存并停止任务，个人数据继续保留。 [升级与卸载](docs/guide/maintenance.md)

## 三步开始

### 1. 选择代理

导入 Clash/Mihomo YAML 订阅或本地配置，选择节点并点击“应用代理”；需要中转时可配置链式代理。[网络与代理](docs/guide/network.md)

### 2. 启动环境

首次选择客机系统或“自动匹配本机系统版本”，再选择存储位置。点击“安装客户机”或“启动 Cage 环境”，按引导完成安装与授权；进度和错误可在“操作详情”查看。以后启动复用原环境。

### 3. 打开项目，运行 Claude

点击“打开项目”选择本机上的文件夹，再新建终端，输入 `claude`，在 Cage 浏览器中完成自己的账户授权。也可以先使用默认工作区，无需提前准备项目。完整步骤见[开始使用](docs/getting-started.md)。

## 使用前了解这些边界

- 共享项目中的修改和删除直接影响本机原文件，包括 Git 操作。请使用版本控制或备份，并核对提交结果。
- 同一份 Cage 配置中的项目共用所选客机系统、工具、账户与文件系统，项目之间没有独立隔离。更换客机系统需要独立安装，原环境的数据继续保留。
- 默认公网出站支持 IPv4 TCP，DNS 通过同一代理；公网 UDP、IPv6、ICMP 及主机和局域网直连受限。主动启用 Tailscale 后，可按私网权限连接设备。
- 网络检查展示当前配置和采样证据，无法保证账户不会受到平台限制，也不能代替完整的虚拟化安全审计。

详细机制见[网络与数据边界](docs/getting-started.md#网络与数据边界)。

      🔍 Study anything
      Websites, desktop apps, phone apps, games and files: real inspection tools find out how they're built and what they do, with the evidence behind every answer.
    
    
      🛠️ Build your own
      Say what you want ("Recreate this website", "Recreate this game's gameplay in Rust") and a coding agent builds a new project in the stack you ask for.
    
    
      ✅ Checked, not guessed
      Every build is compared with the original (pages at three screen widths, a game's own self-test, an app's runs) and refined until it's close.
    
    
      🤖 Agent-ready
      320 tools, each one a CLI command and an MCP tool, so any agent can drive the same engine the app uses. No AI is needed to inspect.
    
  

## How it works

Point Craft Anything at a target, say what you want, and press Start. It works in four steps,
asking you in plain words when a decision is yours:

1. **Study:** inspect the original: its pages at every width, its code, its files, how it runs.
2. **Build:** a coding agent builds a new project, in the language, framework or engine your
   request names (or a sensible default).
3. **Check:** compare the build with the original and list what doesn't match yet.
4. **Ready:** open, play or preview the result, or ask for changes and it refines it.

  
    
      
      Make: pick what to recreate, say what you want, press Start.
    
    
      
      Ready: play the game, or ask for changes below.
    
  

## Two ways to use it

- **Simple** (default): "What do you want to make?" Pick a website, app or game, describe it,
  press Start. A project page shows the four steps (Study → Build → Check → Ready), what the
  agent is doing in plain words, question and approval cards, how alike the result is, and
  buttons to open the result or its folder. Ask for changes in the box at the bottom.
  "Just look inside" opens a target for questions without building anything (in Deep mode).
- **Advanced**: the full workbench: every tool (Ctrl/Cmd+K), functions, strings, pseudo-C,
  disassembly, hex, call graphs, evidence, unknowns, jobs, logs and the agent console.

Both modes drive the same engine.

## Clean room or Deep

- **Clean room** (the default): nothing inside the original is read, not its code, files or page
  source. Craft Anything works from what you can see: pictures you add, the website as a visitor
  sees it (screenshots, visible text, measured layout, colours, fonts and spacing, menus opened)
  and, when you allow it, a picture of the app's window. Tools that would look inside are refused
  and say how to turn on Deep mode.
- **Deep**: every tool is used, for your private use. A program's code and files are read with the
  built-in engines (and Ghidra when it's installed), a website's JavaScript is read and its start
  page watched, and the builder may use all of them.

Clean room is a rule about what Craft Anything offers and refuses. It is not an operating-system
sandbox: it doesn't isolate your computer. A coding agent you run still acts as you, and what it can
read, write or run depends on its own permissions. Which of an agent's own tools Craft Anything can
refuse differs by agent; for Claude Code's tools in chats and questions, see
[`docs/claude-code.md`](docs/claude-code.md).

Switch in the title bar or Settings, with `settings_set deep_mode true`, or for one CLI run with
`--deep` (or `--clean-room`).

  
  
  Advanced: functions, pseudo-C, the agent and the evidence behind every answer.

## AI

Building needs a coding agent on your computer. **Claude Code** is supported first: Craft
Anything runs your own, unmodified `claude` program, which uses your own sign-in; Craft Anything
never sees or handles your account. Your use of it falls under your own agreement with
Anthropic. See [docs/claude-code.md](docs/claude-code.md) for how and why. A Codex adapter
exists but hasn't been verified on a real install yet. **GitHub Copilot** can use your installed
Copilot CLI through ACP: sign in separately with `copilot login`. **Grok Build** can use your
installed `grok` program through ACP (`grok agent stdio`): sign in separately with `grok login`.
See [docs/grok.md](docs/grok.md). Other agents that speak ACP (Gemini CLI,
Qwen Code, opencode, goose, Hermes, Maki, Devin) can be switched to it per backend; of those, Maki
and Devin have been run live (Devin authenticates with the backend's stored key — its own CLI
sign-in doesn't count over ACP). Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, xAI (Grok, when `XAI_API_KEY` is
set) and local OpenAI-compatible servers are available for questions and analysis (Settings → AI).

## Built for agents

Every tool is also a CLI subcommand and an MCP tool, so an agent can study a target or run a
whole rebuild without the app:

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Nintendo Switch 2) running natively on Windows & Linux, with no emulator.

Hookshot is a static recompilation. The game's code is translated to C and compiled into a Windows or Linux program,
the console's system software is reimplemented, and the Switch 2 graphics are rebuilt on Vulkan. All of this happens
**on your PC, from your own copy of the game**.

> [!WARNING]
> Some users report the file in releases to be a Trojan - it is not. Feel free to run it through any antivirus software

Discord: https://discord.gg/rexed

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This repository **does not contain the game, keys or an executable**, and it does not explain how to get them. You
> need your own copy. Everything the build creates (`hookshot.exe`, the generated code, the shader caches and your
> saves) comes from your game and stays on your PC. Never share those files.

## Project status

Experimental. Players have reported on many PCs, from Kokiri Forest to the dungeons: the table says what works and
what does not yet. Open problems are collected in tracking issues, linked below.

| What | Status |
|---|---|
| Kokiri Forest: reaching gameplay and walking around | ✅ Works |
| Sound, controller, keyboard and saves | ✅ Works |
| In-game menu, frame generation and upscaling | ✅ Works |

| Models with missing pieces (doors, fences, parts of trees) | ✅ Fixed where tested, more play needed |
| Stutter when entering new areas | ⚠️ Still happens the first time you visit a place. The next visits are smooth |
| Performance | ⚠️ Depends on the PC: some reach a steady 60 fps, others stay below it, more so in Hyrule Field |
| Hyrule Field, Castle Town, Kakariko and the dungeons | ⚠️ Players got there, with open bugs: lighting and shadows ([#1004](https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/issues/1004)), crashes and freezes ([#2507](https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/issues/2507)) |
| Ultrawide and 4:3 | ✅ Works. The Aspect ratio row's default, Monitor's shape, widens the 3D to the screen and keeps the HUD and movies in the middle 16:9 ([#2119](https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/pull/2119)) |
| NVIDIA cards | ✅ Works. The most tested |
| AMD cards | ⚠️ Many tested: reports from the RX 6600, RX 6800 XT, RX 7800 XT, RX 7900 XTX and RX 9070 XT. | Linux | ✅ Works with the AppImage. Tested on several distributions (CachyOS, Fedora, Bazzite, SteamOS) and cards, with open problems on some AMD cards ([#1000](https://github.com/NotRexed/Hookshot/issues/1000)) |

# Mister Download Manager

  

Downloads faster than IDM. Free, forever.

  Windows 10 and 11 · Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Fedora, openSUSE, Arch and more) · macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel, experimental)
  86 languages · no ads, no trial, no sign-up

  
    5×Fastera 1 GB file: 1 s instead of 5.5 s
    +46More languages86 instead of IDM's 40
    100%Cheaper (free!)no licence, no trial, ever
    TorrentSupported fullymagnet links, .torrent files, seeding
  

  
    
    
  

  
  
  
  
  
  
  

| 🚀 [Download](#download) | ⚡ [Why switch](#why-switch-from-idm) | 🖼️ [Screenshots](#screenshots) | ✨ [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md) | 📜 [Help and tutorials](docs/README.md) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Why switch from IDM?

**Same window you know. Your downloads finish sooner. And it costs nothing.**

  
    
    
  

| | Mister Download Manager | IDM 6.42 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Download a big file (1 GB) | **1 second** | 5.5 seconds |
| Download a small file | **instantly** | 3.1 seconds |
| Download over a shaky connection | **1.6 seconds** | 5.4 seconds |
| Wait before a download starts | **instantly** | 3.1 seconds |
| Price | **Free, forever** | Paid, after a 30-day trial |
| Ads, nag screens, sign-up | **None** | Registration needed |
| Open source | **Yes** (GPL) | No |

Nothing new to learn: the toolbar, the categories, the list of downloads, the progress window and
the browser button are where you expect them. Measured on the same computer, same files, both
programs at their default settings ([how we measured](#the-benchmark-in-detail)).

## Download

  
  
  

On the [download page](https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/releases/latest), pick
one:

| File | Choose it when |
| --- | --- |
| **`...-setup.exe`** | **Not sure? Take this one.** It installs MDM, connects it to your browser and asks your language. |
| `...-portable.zip` | You want MDM on a USB stick or without installing: unzip and run. Everything stays in its folder. |
| `...-x64.zip` | You want the plain programs without an installer. |
| `...-extension-chromium.zip` | You want to add the browser extension by hand (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi). From the stores is easier: [Add to Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/mister-download-manager/ejoleppdfgjdndddcjoehopknmlglojp), [Add to Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/mister-download-manager/). |

> [!NOTE]
> Windows may say *"Windows protected your PC"* the first time, because this early version isn't
> code-signed yet. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

Or with [WinGet](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/package-manager/winget/), Windows' package
manager: in a terminal, the first line installs MDM and the second updates it.

```
winget install AhmedNefzaoui.MisterDownloadManager
winget upgrade AhmedNefzaoui.MisterDownloadManager
```

### On Linux

MDM runs on Linux too, tested on Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 and Fedora with GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce
and Cinnamon, on X11 and in Wayland sessions: the tray, dark mode, browser integration (Ubuntu's
Snap Firefox included) and the packages' installs. Not there yet: screen readers (Orca) don't
read its windows, and Flatpak browsers can't reach it ([more](docs/getting-started.md#on-linux)).
Up to version 0.2.4, the files' names end in `-experimental`.

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `...-linux-x86_64.deb` | Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Pop!_OS: `sudo apt install ./.deb`. |
| `...-linux-x86_64.rpm` | Fedora, openSUSE, RHEL: `sudo dnf install ./.rpm`. |
| `...-linux-x86_64.AppImage` | Any Linux. Make it executable and run it. |
| `...-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | The plain programs, for any distribution. |

  
    
    
  

### On a Mac? Be the first to try it

Fresh builds for **macOS** (Apple Silicon and Intel) are on the same download page, marked
`-experimental`: we haven't tried them on a Mac ourselves yet. Give them a go and
[tell us how it went](https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/issues/new/choose); you'll
help make them as solid as the Windows and Linux versions.

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `...-macos-arm64-experimental.dmg` | Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later). Open it and drag MDM to Applications. The first time, right-click the app and choose **Open**. |
| `...-macos-x86_64-experimental.dmg` | Mac with an Intel processor, the same way. |

## 🌍 In your language

Every language Windows 11 offers, **86 in all**. MDM asks on its first start, and you can change
it any time in **View → Language**. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur get a fully mirrored,
right-to-left window.

## Screenshots

  
    One click on YouTube: the Download video button appears over the video.
    Any video on any page: drag the button where you like, it stays there.
  
  
    Watch it fly: every connection's share of the file, live speed and time left.
    Dark mode that follows Windows.
  
  
    Add a download: paste a link, or let MDM catch it from your browser.
    Torrents and magnet links: pick the files you want, skip the rest.
  
  
    A torrent's progress: its files, peers, trackers and pieces, in tabs.
    A video's progress: speed and time left while yt-dlp brings it in.
  
  
    86 languages, chosen by flag on the first start.
    Right to left for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur.
  
  
    Download overnight: queues that start and stop on their own.
    Options where you expect them, every control working.
  

## What it does

- **Speeds up every download** by fetching parts of the file at the same time, and keeps
  re-balancing until the last byte.
- **Resumes** after a crash, a restart or a dropped connection, without starting

## 可以做什么

DSH Go 提供聊天界面、本机运行环境和远程连接，是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的第三方项目。运行在手机上的是 DSH 引擎；模型请求仍由你配置的模型提供方处理。

- **本机运行**：在 App 内安装 Ubuntu、Node.js 与 DSH 运行环境，无需 Root 或另装 Termux。
- **远程连接**：通过 SSH 或李国宝老师开发的 [DSHarness Remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote) 使用电脑、服务器上的 DSH。
- **聊天与工具**：切换模型，发送图片、使用语音输入，处理工具审批和提问；支持聊天界面与网页模式。
- **插件界面**：使用适配 DSH Go 的原生工具卡、表单和面板；仓库提供 SDK、教程和示例。
- **手机操控**：在你开启权限后，让本机引擎读取屏幕、点按和输入，并可随时停止。
- **分享与外观**：分享、导出和回放对话，调整主题、图标和桌宠。

功能随主机和连接方式不同。DSHarness Remote 当前只支持图片附件，不能在 App 内打开网页版，插件管理限于开关，且不支持 DS Bot 和对话日志导出。详见[本机引擎与远程主机](docs/guide/zh/03-engine-hosts.md)。

## 安装

安装要求为 Android 8.0（API 26）及以上。Release 页面上的 **arm64** 安装包适用于常见的 64 位 Android 手机；x86_64 设备和模拟器用的 x64 包在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。仓库没有 32 位 ARM 构建。

1. 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/latest) 或[官网下载页](https://go.dshtui.com/download)下载对应架构的 APK，并按系统提示允许该安装来源。
2. 首次启动时，选择在本机安装运行环境，或连接远程主机。
3. 为所选主机配置模型和所需凭据，再开始对话；部分远程渠道需要在主机侧配置。

仅连接远程主机时，不必在手机上安装本机运行环境。手机操控只对正常模式下的本机引擎开放，需要按界面说明开启无障碍等权限；不打扰模式另外要求 Android 14 及以上，以及 Shizuku 或自连 ADB。首次使用可按[使用指南](docs/guide/README.md)逐项配置。

本地引擎默认使用 PRoot 兼容启动。开发者选项中的直接启动默认关闭，开启后的兼容性和回退方式见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。当前 Android 构建以 APK 侧载为目标，不是 Google Play 发布配置。

## 数据与权限

模型请求会发送给你配置的提供方。开启手机操控后，任务需要的屏幕文字可能发送给模型，支持看图的模型也可能收到截图；请先阅读 App 的权限说明。

“发送匿名使用统计”默认开启，可在首次引导或“设置 → 隐私与分享”关闭。采集范围和关闭后的处理见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。分享内容前，请检查预览；收到链接或文件的人可以保存其中的内容。

## 风险提示与免责声明

DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方项目，与 DeepSeek 无关联，也不代表 DeepSeek。使用前请了解：

- **AI 并非万无一失**：回答、代码和操作可能出错，也可能被网页、消息或文件中的恶意指令误导。请核验重要结果；医疗、法律、投资等高风险决策不应仅依赖 AI 输出。
- **工具会产生真实影响**：本机或远程主机上的命令、文件修改及手机操控可能导致数据丢失、隐私泄露、账号、资金或设备损失。免确认、放宽应用规则或解除限制会减少保护；确认与拦截机制不能保证消除所有风险。建议保留默认保护，只授予必要权限，不在存有支付或银行信息的设备上解除限制。详见[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。

- **使用前做好防护**：备份重要数据，只连接可信主机、安装可信插件，留意模型用量与费用；不要让 AI 无人值守地处理不可逆或高风险任务。

## 常见问题

和 DeepSeek 官方是什么关系？

没有关系。DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方客户端，基于开源的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 构建。手机上运行的是 DSH 本身；模型请求发给你配置的模型提供方，需要联网，按你在提供方的账户计费。

安全吗？

本机网页版只接受 App 自己的访问。分享链接端到端加密，密钥只在链接里，服务器看不到内容，但获得完整链接的人可以读取并保存内容。手机操控默认保留敏感操作保护；放宽应用规则或开启「解除限制」会减少这些保护。安全机制不能保证零风险，详见[风险提示与免责声明](#风险提示与免责声明)和[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。

切到后台会被杀吗？

部分系统的省电策略会拦住后台。DSH Go 发现后会提醒你，并直达对应的放行设置，vivo、小米、华为、荣耀、OPPO 都有。

对手机有什么要求？

Android 8 及以上。手机直接下载 Release 页面上的安装包即可，模拟器用的 x86_64 版在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。在手机上运行 DSH 要先准备内置的运行环境，请预留约 1 GB 空间；只连电脑或服务器上的 DSH 可以不装。

开源吗？

开源，代码就在这个仓库，以 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) 发布，`sdk/` 和 `examples/` 为 MIT。DSH Go 的名称和标识，以及 Deepy、鲸娘两位吉祥物，不在开源授权范围内，见 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md)。再发布和 fork 时的署名要求见[授权范围与再发布](#授权范围与再发布)。

## 从源码构建

以下流程面向 **Linux x86_64**。当前工具链脚本默认安装 JDK 17、Flutter 3.47.7 和 Android SDK/NDK；App 要求 Dart `^3.13.5`。准备 Bash、Git、curl、tar、unzip、xz、Python 3、zstd（Python 未提供 `compression.zstd` 时用于解包 zstd 压缩的 deb）、file 和常见 GNU 命令；重新解析 Ubuntu 软件包锁时还需要 gpgv。

先取得完整源码和项目资源。`app/pubspec.yaml` 声明的字体、图片等都是构建输入，运行时包由下面的脚本生成。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go.git
cd dsh-go

bash tooling/setup-toolchain.sh
source tooling/env.sh
flutter --version
java -version

bash runtime/build-runtime.sh arm64-v8a
DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f arm64 --keep-daemon
```

工具链脚本会下载 SDK/NDK 与模拟器镜像，并执行 Android SDK 许可接受步骤。默认安装到 `~/dev`；可通过 `DEV_ROOT` 指定独立目录。脚本会复用已有安装，构建前请核对版本。

产物为 `app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-release.apk`。运行时构建使用仓库固定的版本与校验信息，并需要联网下载依赖。示例中的 `DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE=` 不嵌入维护者的内测通道令牌；`--keep-daemon` 保留 Gradle daemon，适合同时开发其他 Android 项目的环境。

构建 x86_64 包时，先生成对应运行时：

```bash
bash runtime/build-runtime.sh x86_64
DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f x64 --keep-daemon
```

未配置 `app/android/key.properties` 时，本地 release 构建使用 debug 签名。它不能直接覆盖不同签名的官方安装包；请在测试设备上安装，保留已有数据，不要为解决签名冲突直接卸载正在使用的 App。发布签名与密钥文件不要提交到仓库。

只查看 APK 构建命令，可运行：

```bash
DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh --dry-run -f all
```

releases.name: v4.13.18
releases.body:
## Security fixes

This release includes fixes for the following security issues:

### `validator()` skips validation for requests whose `Content-Type` parameters are formatted differently

Affects: `validator('json')` and `validator('form')` in `hono/validator`. A `Content-Type` with whitespace before `;`, a trailing `;`, or an unusual parameter name was not recognized, so the validator saw an empty object while the handler could read all fields. This completes the fix for GHSA-4h7h-rv7c-7m2v. The validator now decides by the media type alone, as `c.req.parseBody()` does. GHSA-92p4-j3wq-jmqx

### `bodyLimit()` keeps every transfer chunk of a request body in memory

Affects: `bodyLimit()` in `hono/body-limit`. A body sent in very small transfer chunks was retained as one object per chunk, so a request within the configured limit could exhaust memory. The body is now buffered in one array bounded by `maxSize`. GHSA-39q9-qp46-w8xg

### `mount()` and `app.mount()` forward a wrong path when a custom `getPath` adds a prefix

Affects: `mount()` in `hono/mount` and `app.mount()` on 4.13.16 and 4.13.17. With a `getPath` that prepends a prefix such as the host name, one segment too many was removed from the forwarded path, so middleware scoped inside the mount prefix could be skipped. The prefix is removed from the routed path again. Paths that would change meaning when forwarded now get 400, and an optional regular expression parameter in a mount path throws. GHSA-h25j-2p75-qj33

### `serveStatic()` serves a path that was decoded twice when `allowPercentInPath` is enabled

Affects: `serveStatic()` in `hono/serve-static` and the runtime adapters, only with `allowPercentInPath: true`. A malformed percent escape in the request path was decoded a second time, so a path that middleware registered on the encoded form did not see could still reach a static file. The file path must now be the same as the routed path, and otherwise the response is 404. GHSA-74fm-fwc7-3fwp

---

Users who rely on `validator()`, `bodyLimit()`, `mount()` with a custom `getPath`, or `serveStatic()` with `allowPercentInPath` are strongly encouraged to upgrade to this version.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/honojs/hono/compare/v4.13.17...v4.13.18
